metaTitle: Custom Made in USA Lanyards | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom made in USA lanyards for your organization. Durable, American-made options perfect for events, schools, and businesses.
introHtml: Custom made in USA lanyards give you the confidence of domestic manufacturing with faster turnaround times and support for American workers. Whether you need 1/2" knitted cotton lanyards for a trade show or 3/4" nylon web lanyards for employee IDs, these products are built to last. Digital sublimation allows full-color logos that won't peel or fade, making them ideal for events, schools, and corporate use.
heroAltText: Custom made in USA lanyards with full-color digital sublimation and breakaway feature for safety and branding.
